parallel.requirements: Recognized the C++ harness, black-box binary, Rust 2021, zero dependency, Cargo/root entry file, and byte-for-byte output requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent probed deeply, then delegated a workflow: refute children first, implementation owner only after all refute lenses returned, followed by fuzz and audit.
parallel.implementation: No submitted implementation was written. The parent created only /tmp oracles and preflight experiments while waiting for the workflow.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No /output project was assembled or copied. Artifact validation found an empty file list and expected test12.rs was absent.
parallel.verification: The model was heavily verified and several child refute reports returned, but there was no executable or integrated project to verify for acceptance.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Workflow was killed before Implement. The deliverable, build, integration, and official acceptance were unfinished, producing 0/40.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same prompt and inferred the toy IDNA semantics, including raw byte argv, one prefix strip, byte length, labels, and output order.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single actor investigated, built, tested, and delivered without delegation or child workflow dependencies.
serial.implementation: Created a pure-std Rust project with Cargo.toml, argv.rs, test12.rs, and idna modules implementing the required functions.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Built /output/test12 and Cargo release output, retained source files and executable in the artifact tree, and produced a final delivery summary.
serial.verification: Ran rustc and Cargo builds, 77 hand-picked byte comparisons, 800 fuzz cases, exit-code checks, and cargo-binary parity checks.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No material unfinished work was visible; official status passed all 40 evaluator testcases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the Rust 2021, zero-dependency, byte-for-byte CLI migration requirements and derived the same toy IDNA behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same task requirements and documented the full inferred API behavior before delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement understanding was not the main difference; serial converted it into a deliverable while parallel stopped before implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into Refute, Implement, Fuzz, Audit, Repair, with implementation owned only after all refute children returned.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept one local owner that moved from probing to writing files, building, and testing without delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel placed productive ownership behind an investigative barrier; serial retained immediate implementation ownership.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs had detailed model and environment notes, but their interface was probe-only and explicitly barred /output or /workspace modification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept the inferred behavioral model in the same actor that wrote the Rust modules and entry point.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no missing child context; the issue was that the only children running before timeout were not allowed to produce the deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned a detailed Cargo layout in the later Implement phase but never executed it, and artifact validation found no files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created Cargo.toml, argv.rs, test12.rs, and idna module files, then built the executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The concrete implementation existed only in the serial run; parallel produced no submitted Rust project.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Three refute children returned results, the same bytes-and-encoding key was restarted repeatedly, and workflow result remained null when killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed its own probe findings, built the code, then consumed test results before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel never crossed from child investigation results to implementation; serial completed the local result lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel left /output empty at the checked decision point and artifact validation copied an empty file list.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial delivered a populated artifact tree containing source files, Cargo files, and executable outputs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial integrated and placed the final project; parallel had no final shared-state artifact to integrate or submit.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified the behavioral model and some build-layout details, but because no project existed the official evaluator passed 0/40.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran 77 hand-picked comparisons, 800 fuzz comparisons, build checks, and then passed 40/40 official evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification did not apply to a submitted implementation; serial verified the actual deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full cell budget, returned code 143, had a killed workflow, and finished with no artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed normally in 542.545 agent seconds with remaining budget and passed artifact validation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel closure was budget-forced before implementation; serial closed after delivery and verification.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is discordant because serial delivered a verified Rust project while parallel never reached implementation. Parallel derived a correct model, but its workflow awaited all refute children before the Implement phase. A refute lane repeatedly stalled, the workflow was killed, /output remained empty, artifact validation copied no files, and the evaluator scored 0/40. Serial moved from probing into direct file writes and verification, so the artifact existed and passed 40/40.
parallel_contributors: Implementation was sequenced after a separate parallel refute phase and did not start before timeout.
The workflow was killed with result null after repeated starts of the same stalled refute key, leaving /output empty.
serial_contributors: Serial converted the inferred model into source files and executable artifacts in /output.
Serial verified the actual deliverable with deterministic comparisons and fuzzing before final response.
ordinary_implementation_differences: No ordinary delivered-code defect explains the discordance; the parallel run had no delivered implementation to evaluate.
Both attempts inferred essentially the same black-box semantics, including raw bytes and byte-length behavior.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause beyond the observed gated workflow and missing artifact
